note: An inventory of Glǽmscrafu with links, at the owner's instruction of 11 August. Nothing of Tolkien's text, nothing of Bellet and Babut's transcriptions, and none of their recordings is reproduced. This says a text exists and where to hear it -- which is what a catalogue does.

audio_held.what: THE RECORDINGS ARE NOW HELD AND SERVED, not linked. His ruling C877, 3 September 2026.
audio_held.supersedes: the credit.statement of 11 August, which read 'AN INVENTORY, NOT A COPY ... It reproduces none of Tolkien's text, none of their transcriptions, and none of their 131 recordings -- a recording is a performance and is theirs.' That was his instruction then. He has ruled otherwise now, in his own words: 'publish the audio too. Our previously used audio on our site was very wrong.'

tolkiens_own_voice.what: J.R.R. TOLKIEN READING HIS OWN ELVISH, from his 1952 recordings. THREE files, and the count is measured rather than inferred: Glaemscrafu keeps them in a directory of their own named `tolkien`, and the page that carries them is headed 'Names and invented words read by Tolkien in The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit'.
tolkiens_own_voice.why_the_count_matters: A first reading of this site put ALL 155 recordings in Tolkien's voice, on a regex finding 'read by Tolkien' 184 times across 179 pages. It is a NAVIGATION MENU ITEM in the bar of every page. This archive had already recorded that exact trap about this exact site on 11 August, when an mp3 test matched 169 of 169 mirror pages because the shared player element sits on every one.

audio_held.everything_else: 152 recordings by Bellet and Babut. The text may be Tolkien's; the reading is theirs, and every licence row says so.
